title: Worked...sort of
text: Worked...sort of. I used this to press out extra liquid from a brick of firm tofu. I was making some lo-mein and wanted the tofu to be a little drier, and more meat-like. It did a great job of getting the liquid out. I would up with about half a cup of liquid in the bottom. However, the spring that provides the tension that presses the tofu is too strong. It squashed the brick of tofu. I could not longer cut it into nice cubes. I had to break it up into rough chunks. If you want tofu that you can cut into cubes, don't use the spring. Just put something in the top to gently weight the press down. It will do a better job than the spring.
